messages:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing the SparkBridge launch flow. Need decisions on: 1) launch post narrative for benchmark tweet/LinkedIn, 2) webinar registration incentive (credits), 3) inbound routing tags + onboarding prompt templates. TL;DR: want tight PLG loop that maps post -> webinar -> first-10-requests activation.
Sam: love it. For the benchmark angle, can we feature a short head-to-head latency/cost stat vs a baseline and link to a 1-min demo clip? audience likes numbers + video.
Jordan: yep — analytics will surface the sample workload bench. I can run a trimmed A/B: (A) numbers-first post, (B) story-first post. We should track click->signup conversion and token usage in first 24h.
Rachel: webinar credit ask — are we doing 500 free tokens or 1000? also length: 30m + 15m q&a.
Kai: recommend 750 credits for webinar registrants who attend (attended check). Gives enough room for a few API calls + try prompts. For non-attendees, send 250 as a follow-up nudge.
Maya: 750/250 sounds reasonable. Can Ops wire the provisioning? tagging rule needs to mark source=webinar_sparkbridge and assign cohort=webinar-2026-03.
Priya: I can make the onboarding prompt pack — 3 starter templates: "quick demo", "customer-support draft", "productivity summarizer". Keep them copy-ready.
Sam: landing page copy idea: "Ship LLM-powered features with predictable latency & cost — see SparkBridge in 60s" CTA: Register for live demo + get credits.
Jordan: routing: inbound webhook -> tag assignment -> create lead in SFDC with field spark_source and credits_granted. Also emit event: marketing.credit_grant. I'll draft required payload.
Maya: ok add a fallback: if quota exhausted on hosted pool, route to dedicated-trial variant and mark in lead notes. Want smooth experience.
Rachel: ops note — provisioning: use promo code pool: SPARKBRIDGE23, TTL 7 days from grant. Automation via /admin/grants API. Sample call: ```POST /admin/grants {"email":"{user}","amount":750,"code":"SPARKBRIDGE23","expires":"2026-03-31"}```
Kai: small experiment: two prompt-template variants in onboarding pack to A/B prompt quality signal (measure via normalized success rate on eval set). Priya will implement variants V1 / V2.
Priya: will do. also adding inline tips for best results and a one-click "try now" that pre-fills API key & prompt.
Sam: deadline for assets? need social copy + demo clip + landing page by Wed EOD so ads can start Thurs.
Maya: Wed EOD works. Jordan — can you confirm analytics event names & GTM mapping by Tue?
Jordan: yep I'll post the schema here by Tue morning.
Priya: quick note on messaging iteration: let's plan 3 subject line variants and rotate for first 2 days, then pick winner by CTR. I suggest subject A: "See high-throughput LLM serving in 60s", B: "How much will LLM inference cost you? (real numbers)", C: "Ship LLM features faster — SparkBridge demo".
Maya: good set. Sam — can you draft the variants and short captions for LinkedIn?
Sam: on it. will drop drafts by Tue lunch.
LintBot: Reminder: calendar invite created for "SparkBridge launch sync" Thu 10:00. Attendees: Maya, Sam, Jordan, Rachel, Kai, Priya.
Maya: thanks LintBot. last operational check — who owns the post-launch cohort analysis? I want a short 72h playbook: top 3 metrics, rollback signals, and follow-up cadences.
Jordan: I'll own 72h cohort analysis + quick dashboard (tokens/day, conversion->first-10-requests, latency distribution). Will push access to #marketing-analytics.
Rachel: Ops will prepare fallback messaging for quota issues and a dedicated support channel for registrants.
Maya: perfect — check-ins: Tue (assets), Wed (landing + automation test), Thu (final go/no-go). If all green we push Fri morning. :rocket:
Sam: excited — small checklist I'll post in thread with links.
Priya: adding prompt pack to docs repo and will open a PR today.
Maya: thanks team, this thread is the single source for decisions.
